costMethod.note: costUsd is the part's share of development cost, not its price. costUsd = anchor price × integrationAndTestFactor. The anchor is a public vendor list price (copied as a figure, named in each part's costUsd source note) or, where no price is public, our own value. The factor stands for integration, testing, spares and engineering labour; it is a starting value, tuned in TODO T7.6. Euro prices are converted at eurToUsd.
